name: Far drift
sentence: How much RNA proseg lets drift far from its cell. Low: RNA mostly counts for the cell it lies in. High: a little more counts for a cell a few µm away.
info: Made-up cells, started from cells only: 36 transcripts of each cell lie 2.5 to 4.5 µm over their shared border. Other settings at proseg's defaults. Each panel: the middle of 27 copies run in proseg 3.2.0. Drift starts at iteration 200; from then on, 9, 16 and 23 of the 72 counted for their own cell on average. On real 500 µm squares the pink dots changed under 8 %, in no steady direction.
spotTip: Bigger dots: RNA lying 2.5 to 4.5 µm over the border from its own cell, in the colour of the cell whose count keeps it.
statTip: Bigger dots counted for their own cell, on average over every 5th iteration since drift began.
